title: Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Made-to-Order Deposit: Amount Charged at Reservation
content:
**Basis.** The deposit on a Pre-Orders & Back-Orders Made-to-Order Reservation is the made-to-order deposit. It is the reserved unit price times the units times the made-to-order deposit percentage, divided by 100. The made-to-order deposit percentage is the deposit percentage of the Made-to-Order Reservation type, its standard made-to-order deposit percentage. The made-to-order deposit is never less than the type's minimum deposit. It is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**Finance questions**

*What is the price the percentage is applied to?*
The reserved unit price on the reservation times its units.

*When is the minimum applied?*
After the percentage has been applied to the price. The deposit is the higher of that amount and the minimum deposit.

*When is it rounded?*
Once, at the end, half up to the cent. Nothing is rounded along the way.

**Worked examples.** These use hypothetical reservations of one pair. The Made-to-Order Reservation type figures used are 50 percent, with a $50.00 minimum.

| Reserved unit price | Price times 50, divided by 100 | Higher of that and $50.00, rounded | Made-to-order deposit |
|---|---|---|---|
| $320.00 | $160.00 | $160.00 | $160.00 |
| $95.00 | $47.50 | $50.00 | $50.00 |
| $287.45 | $143.725 | $143.73 | $143.73 |
